# The Dig

> The Dig pools estate sales from the public listing boards into one map per city. Facts shown, always linked back to the source listing.

## What it is
- A free map and list of estate sales, one page per city, rebuilt once a day from public JSON feeds.
- Each sale shows what its source listing published: title, company, dates, hours, and the full street address whenever the feed has it. While an address is still held, the sale page shows the city and ZIP and says when it releases: 9:00 AM the day before the first sale day.
- When a feed carries them, a sale page also shows: a Dig rating (Deep Dig, Worth a Look or Slim Pickings) with the reasons for it, a one-line contents summary and keyword chips describing what is being sold, how many photos are at the source (the photos stay at the source and are never copied), and Call and Company page buttons when the source publishes a phone or a company page. Every sale page and sale card has a Directions link, every sale day has an Add to calendar download, and every sale card and page has a heart so a visitor can keep favorites in their own browser. Features appear only when that sale's feed record carries the field behind them.
- The Dig does not run or verify sales. The source listing is the authority.

## Cities
Live and proving are what the city index said when this site was built. Texas is first. More states are being scouted and none is named until it has a real feed.

### Live
- Houston: https://rheinze08.github.io/the-dig-web/houston/
  This weekend: https://rheinze08.github.io/the-dig-web/houston/this-weekend/
  JSON feed: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rheinze08/the-dig-data/main/cities/houston/sales.json
  32 sales in the feed, collected 2026-11-21T17:51:13.941Z. Times are America/Chicago.

A proving city's pages carry a "Preview — still proving itself" banner. Its counts are real, and a sale can be missing.

## Regions and search
- Regions page (live cities, preview cities, what comes next): https://rheinze08.github.io/the-dig-web/regions/
- Search page, across every live and proving city: https://rheinze08.github.io/the-dig-web/search/
  Link straight to a search: https://rheinze08.github.io/the-dig-web/search/?q=<words>&cat=<category-id>[,<category-id>]. Add &fav=1 to open the Favorites-only view (favorites are stored in the visitor's browser only; there is no account and nothing is sent to a server).
- Search data the page filters in the browser: https://rheinze08.github.io/the-dig-web/search/data.json
  221 records, one per sale page: id, city, title, company, categories, first and last day, lat, lng, sale page URL, source listing URL. A record also carries keywords, contentsLine and digRating when that sale's feed record has them.
- Category ids: tools, furniture, vinyl-records, jewelry, collectibles, vehicles, kitchen, clothing, books, art, electronics, toys-games
- A keyword matches the start of any word in a sale's title, company, categories, photo keywords or contents line.

## Public data
- City index: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rheinze08/the-dig-data/main/cities.json
- Combined search feed, every sale from the live and proving cities in one file: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rheinze08/the-dig-data/main/search.json
  Published. This site takes each sale's categories from it.
- Per-city feeds follow the pattern https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rheinze08/the-dig-data/main/cities/<slug>/sales.json
- In a feed, "addressHidden": true means no street address has been released and the map point is approximate.

## Pages
- One page per sale: https://rheinze08.github.io/the-dig-web/sale/<sale-id>/ where <sale-id> is the sale's "id" in the feed. Each has schema.org Event data, a Directions link, and a favorite heart.
- One calendar file per sale day: https://rheinze08.github.io/the-dig-web/sale/<sale-id>/<YYYY-MM-DD>.ics with the day's hours, the address (or the city and ZIP and release time while it is held), the contents line when the feed has one, and links to the sale page and the original listing.
- Sale pages are removed when a sale leaves the feed.
- Sitemap: https://rheinze08.github.io/the-dig-web/sitemap.xml

## How to cite
Link the sale's page on The Dig and the source listing that page names. Example:
"Estate sale listed on The Dig (https://rheinze08.github.io/the-dig-web/sale/<sale-id>/), original listing: <source listing URL>."
Do not present The Dig as the organizer of a sale.

## Contact
No contact address is live yet. listings@thedig.example is a placeholder and does not receive mail.
